rewrite.title: Population Growth Fell 54% Since 1972
rewrite.hook: Population growth dropped from 2 in 1972 to 0.91—and almost nobody noticed.
rewrite.closing: The world did not stop growing. It just quietly hit the brakes.
rewrite.question: Did you realize population growth had slowed this much?
says: In 1972, rural population was 63.1 % of total population. By 2025, it was 42.2 % of total population—just 67 percent of the earlier share.
In 1972, population in the largest city was 18.2 % of urban population. By 2025, it was 16.2 % of urban population—barely moved while the world around it urbanized.
In 1972, population growth was 2 annual %. By 2025, it was 0.91 annual %—down to 46 percent of that earlier pace. That is not a slowdown; that is the demographic brakes coming on.
